post.hook: Mistral goes 1T open as AI security slips
post.subhook: Three security findings, an Anthropic deal and OpenAI policy updates

stories.headline: Mistral opens weights for Large 4, a 1T-parameter multimodal MoE
stories.detail: Mistral claims it beats open rivals at coding; independent testing puts it behind top Chinese models.

stories.headline: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used DeepSeek in attacks
stories.detail: State-linked attackers used DeepSeek and other AI tools against 200+ organizations, including governments and businesses.

stories.headline: GLM 5.3 turned unshipped Firefox fixes into working exploits
stories.detail: Epoch AI reports one-click exploits at about $1,000 each, suggesting AI can exploit the gap between patch and update.

stories.headline: Contractor's personal Claude agent sat on a Pentagon network
stories.detail: The agent ran for two months before it was discovered; the vulnerability has since been patched.

stories.detail: The company ran its drug program using Claude, a sign of AI labs moving into drug development.

stories.detail: Sets out the behavioral principles OpenAI says its models should follow as they become more capable.

post.caption:
Mistral put a 1T-parameter open-weight model on the table, and three separate reports show AI landing squarely in security work.

Leads:
1. Mistral releases open weights for Large 4, a 1T-parameter multimodal MoE. Mistral claims it beats open rivals at coding; independent testing puts it behind top Chinese models. (Mistral)
2. China-linked hackers used DeepSeek and other AI tools in attacks on 200+ organizations, per CrowdStrike. (Techmeme)
3. GLM 5.3 turned unshipped Firefox security fixes into working one-click exploits at about $1,000 each. (Epoch AI)
4. A defense contractor's personal Claude agent ran on a Pentagon network for two months before discovery. The vulnerability has since been patched. (Wired)
5. Anthropic acquires a one-person biotech that ran a drug program with Claude. (Forbes)

Briefs:
6. OpenAI publishes an updated Model Spec with five core values. (OpenAI)
7. OpenAI doubles usage limits across paid plans, reversing a planned Pro 200 cut. (The Decoder)
8. Global AI computing capacity additions are doubling every nine months, about 2.5x per year since 2024. (Epoch AI)
9. New York enacts a ban on unsafe chatbots for kids. (Times of India)

The patch gap just got shorter. 🔒

clusters.headline: Mistral releases open weights for Large 4 (Le Chonk), a 1T-parameter multimodal MoE model
clusters.why_it_matters: Gives practitioners a very large open-weight multimodal model they can self-host, with Mistral claiming it beats open rivals at coding, though independent testing puts it behind top Chinese models.

clusters.headline: China-linked hackers used DeepSeek and other AI tools in attacks on 200+ organizations, per CrowdStrike
clusters.why_it_matters: Shows state-linked attackers using commercial AI models operationally against governments and businesses worldwide.

clusters.headline: Epoch AI reports GLM 5.3 turned unshipped Firefox security fixes into working one-click exploits
clusters.why_it_matters: Suggests the window between a patch being published and users receiving it may be exploitable by AI at about $1,000 per exploit.

clusters.headline: A defense contractor's personal Claude agent ran on a Pentagon network for two months before discovery
clusters.why_it_matters: Shows personal AI agents can gain access to secure government systems without detection, and that the vulnerability has since been patched.

clusters.headline: Anthropic acquires a one-person biotech that ran a drug program with Claude
clusters.why_it_matters: Shows an AI lab acquiring a company that ran a drug program using its model, a sign of AI moving into drug development work.

clusters.headline: OpenAI publishes an updated Model Spec with five core values
clusters.why_it_matters: Sets out the behavioral principles OpenAI says its models should follow as they become more capable.

clusters.headline: OpenAI doubles usage limits across paid plans, reversing a planned Pro 200 cut
clusters.why_it_matters: Gives paying users substantially more capacity on OpenAI's models as competition with Anthropic intensifies.

clusters.headline: Epoch AI finds global AI computing capacity additions doubling every nine months
clusters.why_it_matters: Quantifies how fast new AI chip compute is being added, about 2.5x per year since 2024.
